## Generic UI handling

The 48 generic modules are:

`accordion`, `alert-dialog`, `alert`, `aspect-ratio`, `avatar`, `badge`, `breadcrumb`, `button`, `calendar`, `card`, `carousel`, `chart`, `checkbox`, `collapsible`, `command`, `context-menu`, `dialog`, `drawer`, `dropdown-menu`, `form`, `hover-card`, `input-otp`, `input`, `label`, `menubar`, `navigation-menu`, `pagination`, `popover`, `progress`, `radio-group`, `resizable`, `scroll-area`, `select`, `separator`, `sheet`, `sidebar`, `skeleton`, `slider`, `sonner`, `switch`, `table`, `tabs`, `textarea`, `toast`, `toaster`, `toggle-group`, `toggle`, `tooltip`.

All have canonical counterparts under [apps/app/src/components/ui](/Users/liamellis/Desktop/apps/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/apps/app/src/components/ui). Forty-five expose the same public component names and should be reused rather than copied.

Exceptions:

- Reference `calendar.tsx` additionally exports `CalendarDayButton`.
- Reference `card.tsx` additionally exports `CardAction`.
- Reference `sidebar.tsx` is a full shadcn sidebar system; the app’s same-named file instead exports `SessionNavBar`.

If “all” is interpreted literally to include scaffolding, add 48 stories against the canonical app primitives, while separately resolving those three API differences. Do not import the prototype implementations. Its `chart.tsx` is already incompatible with the target’s Recharts version.

## Exclusions

No standalone stories are warranted for:

- `theme-provider.tsx`: provider behavior belongs in the global Storybook decorator.
- `ui/use-mobile.tsx`, `hooks/use-mobile.ts`: hooks; cover through viewport stories.
- `use-toast.ts`, `hooks/use-toast.ts`: duplicate hook modules.
- Three `index.ts` barrels.
- `types/documents.ts`, `lib/utils.ts`, `lib/fonts.ts`.
- `app/layout.tsx`: metadata/font application shell.
- Config files, Markdown implementation notes, lockfile, and `.DS_Store`.

## Build/runtime blockers

A direct typecheck reports 31 errors.

Critical defects:

- [DocumentFrame.tsx](/Users/liamellis/Desktop/apps/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/docs/design/reference-prototype/components/DocumentFrame.tsx:1) imports nonexistent `@/types/document`; the file is `types/documents.ts`.
- `DocumentOne`, `DocumentA`, `DocumentB`, `ClassifiedDocument`, `UFODispatchDocument`, and `WeatheredClassifiedDocument` have shallow `Required<>` typing and unsafe optional nested data.
- `MixedDocumentLayout` indexes an optional array type incorrectly.
- Prototype `chart.tsx` is incompatible with Recharts 3 in the target.
- `WeatheredClassifiedDocument` renders `PhotoCaption` twice.
- Its `/weathered` and `/` links would navigate away from Storybook.
- `DocumentA`, `DocumentB`, and dispatch documents declare caption props but hardcode or ignore them.
- Poster image/avatar props are declared but never rendered.
- Dynamic Tailwind strings such as `rotate-${rotation}` are unreliable because Tailwind cannot statically discover them.
- `ClassifiedDocument` depends on a remote grain texture.
- Fixed `768×1152` posters and `min-h-screen` wrappers need story-specific scaling.

## Styles and assets

Do not import the prototype’s 651-line `app/globals.css` wholesale. Its first 130 lines redefine Tailwind/theme globals, while selectors such as `.document-texture`, `.noise-pattern`, `.glow-effect`, and font utilities collide with [research-ui.css](/Users/liamellis/Desktop/apps/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/apps/app/src/app/research-ui.css). Generic names like `.label`, `.poster`, and `.mono` are especially dangerous.

Use a scoped `reference-prototype.css` beneath `[data-reference-prototype]`, move paper variables onto that wrapper, and prefix its keyframes.

Of 16 public assets:

- Six are directly used: four document PNGs, the Socorro JPG, and `placeholder.svg`.
- Two PP Neue Montreal TTFs are referenced by the prototype font module.
- Eight icons/logos/placeholders are unused.

Copy only needed assets into a namespaced directory such as:

`apps/app/public/reference-prototype/`

Then rewrite component URLs. Reuse the app’s existing font setup and Storybook font stubs instead of copying the broken prototype `fonts.ts`, which references several local font files that do not exist in the prototype.

## Framework integration

Prototype:

- Next 14.2
- React 19
- strict TypeScript
- Tailwind 4
- shadcn `new-york`
- pnpm

Target:

- Next 15.5
- React 19.2
- Tailwind 4
- Storybook 9.1.6
- Bun monorepo

The target already includes every direct runtime dependency except `@radix-ui/react-toast`. Reusing target primitives also avoids version drift in Recharts and `react-resizable-panels`.

Storybook currently discovers only `src/**/*.stories.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)` and serves only `apps/app/public`; use CSF TSX stories, not MDX.
